gem5_config._comment: Modeled dual-issue in-order RVV core (MinorCPU). Cache sizes X60-ish; latencies are se.py defaults pending board calibration — report results as relative kernel comparisons, not SpacemiT K1 numbers.

protocol._comment: warm = headline kernel-cost protocol: untimed invocation grows arena + warms caches, then timed invocation with the determinism check. Costs ~2x sim time per run. cold = single invocation with allocator syscalls + first-touch faults inside ROI — an end-to-end number, not kernel isolation; gem5 SE fault handling is not representative of real HW. Use mode_overrides to drop the largest matrices to cold if warm's 2x sim time is prohibitive, and report those separately.
